summary: New nether biomes don t work properly in buffet worlds
description: The bug The new nether biomes (nether wastes, soul sand valley, crimson forest, warped forest and basalt deltas) do not work in Surface or Floating Island Buffet worlds. To reproduce - Create New World - Select More World Options - Make a buffet world - Select Soul Sand Valley - Set terrain type to Floating Islands or Surface Floating Island mode Freezes the game before it even loads terrain (Image Below) -Surface mode creates a purely ocean world (This happened the first time i tried to make one but works fine now for some reason) The following list is updated in version 20w15a: Biomes All world generators that freeze the game Nether wastes Surface Crimson forest Surface Warped forest Surface and floating islands Soul sand valley Surface Basalt deltas Surface
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new world and select "More World Options".
3. Choose the "Buffet" world type.
4. Select "Soul Sand Valley" as the biome.
5. Set the terrain type to either "Floating Islands" or "Surface Floating Island mode".
6. Start the world generation process.
7. Observe that the game freezes before it even loads any terrain.

8. Alternatively, set the terrain type to "Surface" and observe that the world generates a purely ocean biome instead of the intended Soul Sand Valley biome.

9. Take note if the game freezes or if the incorrect biome is generated as described above.
Observed Behavior:
The new Nether biomes (Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, and Basalt Deltas) do not function properly in Surface or Floating Island Buffet worlds. To reproduce the issue, create a new world, select More World Options, choose to make a buffet world, pick one of these Nether biomes such as Soul Sand Valley, and set the terrain type to either Floating Islands or Surface Floating Island mode. This configuration causes the game to freeze before it even loads any terrain. In some cases, setting the terrain type to Surface creates a purely oceanic world, which previously worked but now sporadically exhibits this behavior again.

The issue affects all Nether biomes and is particularly problematic with Basalt Deltas due to its unique generation mechanics involving basalt pillars. This problem persists across multiple versions of Minecraft, including 20w15a. When attempting to load a world in the specified conditions, the game may hang at low loading percentages for an extended period or freeze entirely, requiring task manager intervention to close it.

Additionally, this bug has been observed with other Nether biomes such as Warped Forest and sometimes Crimson Forest, indicating a broader issue with how these biomes are handled in Surface and Floating Island modes.
Expected Behavior: When creating a buffet world with any of the new Nether biomes (Nether Wastes, Soul Sand Valley, Crimson Forest, Warped Forest, and Basalt Deltas) in Surface or Floating Island modes, the game should successfully generate the selected biome without freezing or getting stuck during loading. The terrain should properly load and display the appropriate features for each chosen Nether biome, allowing players to explore and interact with the environment as expected.
